services.name: Tyee Charters
services.desc: For river fishing we use a 17′ Hyde drift boat. We have a forced air heater for those cold winter days. A drift boats special design allows for shallow draft and nimble performance when navigating the rivers of the Olympic Peninsula in Seattle, WA. Our Saltwater charter boat is a 2005, 24-foot Alumaweld Formula Vee. She is powered by twin Yamaha 150hp 4 stroke with 300hp which means we are first to the fishing grounds! A spacious cabin and a large fishing cockpit give our anglers plenty of room for fighting fish. blurb: Tyee Charters offers daily salmon fishing trips departing from Seattle or Bainbridge Island. Trips include 6-hour morning and 4-hour afternoon options. They fish for salmon, lingcod, and halibut in Puget Sound, with opportunities to see local wildlife such as porpoise and whales.
